name: Hand-Release Push-Up

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Tactical Strength & Conditioning Joint Protection Standard

steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your body forming a straight line from heels to head.
Lower your chest and thighs smoothly to the floor in a controlled manner.
Once resting fully on the floor, lift both hands a few inches off the ground, squeezing your shoulder blades together briefly.
Place your hands firmly back on the mat beneath your shoulders.
Brace your core and press the floor away, driving your body back up in one cohesive unit to the top plank position.
coaching_cues: Do not allow your hips to peel off the floor after your chest; your body must rise as a single rigid board.
Lifting the hands at the bottom eliminates joint bouncing and resets shoulder mechanics.
Keep elbows angled back at roughly 45 degrees, not flared out perpendicular to your body.

sources.attribution: NSCA Tactical Strength Joint Preservation Protocol
